reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount like the other providers, but the transaction download and account listing are new per-provider copies instead of shared request code.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions and fintegraAccounts a copy of akahuAccounts, differing only in the server URL and log text.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the other providers' counterparts live: link handler and listing in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested fintegra-accounts listing handler and touches desktop-client files although the request is server-side only (the client edits follow from widening SYNC_PROVIDERS).

maintainability.why: The link path is shared, but every future change to the download or listing request shape must now be repeated in one more copy.
